verdict.rationale: Figma's REST API and Plugin API expose read/write/create/modify access across files and objects, which developers can script to perform bulk operations (e.g., extracting or modifying many layers/components at once), and community evidence confirms users rely on 'bulk export plugins' to batch-process assets like icons. However, this capability is not a native built-in bulk-operations feature — it requires third-party plugins or custom API scripting, and community feedback (figma-comm-2, figma-comm-3) explicitly describes the default manual, one-by-one workflow as tedious before a workaround plugin is applied. Missing for 10: a documented first-party bulk-edit/bulk-export feature, evidence of AI-native agents performing bulk operations via MCP at scale, and confirmation that the MCP server itself supports batched multi-item writes rather than single-object edits.
